items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday after exiting Week 4 early; consecutive DNPs put Week 5 status vs JAX in serious doubt and week-to-week.
items.implication: Likely OUT or limited; elevates Eagles RB depth
items.opportunity: Lead back role opens for Shipley/others if OUT

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for second straight day, joining Barkley on DNP list ahead of London game.
items.implication: High risk of OUT; thins Eagles WR room with Brown also out
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining WRs/TE if inactive

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle injury; Friday practice looms large for Sunday night availability in Atlanta.
items.why: Ankle from prior game; key Friday test
items.implication: Questionable/OUT risk; impacts Ravens stack and Likely/Andrews
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup QB + more Likely usage

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot); consecutive DNPs with OTs also out.
items.implication: Likely limited/OUT vs DEN; elevates other Chargers WRs
items.opportunity: Route/target share to Johnston/others if inactive

items.text: Broncos coach Sean Payton confirming he is taking over offensive play-calling this week (change from OC Webb).
items.why: Payton more heavily involved; confirmed to reporters
items.implication: Potential scheme/pace boost for DEN skill players

items.text: If Breece Hall (quad, DNP/week-to-week, missed prior) is out, Braelon Allen is top-20 RB this week; Berry ranks Allen just above Wilson.
items.opportunity: 100% RB touches/snaps to Allen as in Week 4

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. re-aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis); coach says will miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Extended absence; opens Steelers WR targets

items.text: Adam Levitan and Evan Silva call it the Will Shipley show vs Jacksonville after Barkley/Bigsby (IR abdomen/core surgery) injuries; Shipley elevated as lead back.
items.implication: Shipley becomes every-down fantasy RB1/2 option in London
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/route share expansion vs soft JAX run D allowing receiving yards

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 5; potential target boost to others if limited

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans as WR8; volume and red-zone usage in soft matchup.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift vs TEN

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload plus Bengals injuries funneling more opportunity.
items.why: Volume vs soft MIA + teammate injuries

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle) and Mark Andrews (TE17) for Week 5 due to tough matchups/thin roles/usage.
Pat Thorman snaps & pace: DET @ ARI up in pace; SF @ SEA slow slog; pair of roll-up-sleeves matchups.
items.implication: Higher volume environment for DET-ARI stack (popular DFS)

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming.
items.opportunity: Efficiency edge for Bijan/Kyren; monitor Jeanty/Brown volume
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown despite under xFP
